rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Formulating an action plan**

I need to create a concise action plan for internal litigation support in five sentences or less. My goals include updating the spreadsheet to differentiate core versus proposed items, adding notes about searches, identifying the strongest follow-ups, and drafting two internal documents: one with 6-8 bullet talking points and another with 4-6 bullet scripts. I’ll also propose language for a follow-up email. It’s crucial to stress accuracy and avoid altering the originals while flagging important items. I plan to deliver everything by late afternoon.
**Crafting a succinct response**

I’m putting together a concise response that outlines key actions. I’ll update the spreadsheet to include Proposed Follow-Up Yes/No and search labels. An internal note will list the custodian set, channels, and core term families. I’ll identify the strongest and high-risk follow-ups, draft talking points along with a magistrate script, and propose a 2-3 sentence follow-up email. I'll deliver all this by 5:00 PM today while ensuring consistency with the coded record and avoiding alterations to originals.
rounds.response: I will update the spreadsheet today to mark which documents are in our existing core pricing/competition searches and add a "Proposed Follow‑Up – Yes/No" field with short search‑label names tied to each thread. I will add a short workspace note enumerating exactly what our current searches covered (custodians, channels, core term families) and flag which of the 3–5 proposed follow‑ups are the strongest/most defensible versus which are optional/high‑risk for surfacing spicy language. I will draft (A) 6–8 non‑adversarial talking points for tomorrow’s meet‑and‑confer and (B) a 4–6 bullet magistrate script keyed to our coding/log setup, and I will propose 2–3 sentences of post‑call email language memorializing agreed search scope. I will flag any specific "crush/kill/dominate" instances and other hot documents for immediate partner/GC review, and I will upload all materials to the workspace by 5:00 PM today without altering any source text or metadata.
